project_type: React 19 + React Router 7 (SSR + SPA dual mode) + Tailwind CSS 4 + Vite 8 frontend
build_system: pnpm in web/ directory. Build command: pnpm build (runs react-router build for SSR mode)
test_framework: No test framework configured (no test script in package.json)
test_command: No test command available. Verify via build only.
verification_instructions: Run `pnpm build` in web/ directory and confirm it completes without errors.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. pnpm store available at /projects/sandbox/.pnpm-store. Node modules installed successfully. No docker available.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md guidelines affecting this task.

key_patterns.custom_link: web/components/common/link.tsx wraps web/lib/router/link.tsx. The lib/router/link.tsx imports Link from react-router-dom (which re-exports react-router). Currently strips the prefetch prop (destructured as _prefetch). React Router 7 Link supports prefetch='intent'|'render'|'viewport'|'none'.
key_patterns.code_splitting: Editors already use React.lazy in web/components/editor/content-editor.tsx (lazy-loads RichTextEditor and MarkdownEditor). GoogleOneTap in root.tsx also uses React.lazy. The markdown-editor.tsx uses a custom dynamic() utility from lib/router/dynamic.tsx which wraps React.lazy.
key_patterns.optimistic_ui: Topic like already has optimistic UI in topic-like-button.tsx and topic-action-context.tsx. Follow button in follow-button.tsx uses useTransition but does NOT have optimistic state toggle.
key_patterns.avatar_component: web/components/common/avatar.tsx renders img tags without loading='lazy' or decoding='async'.
key_patterns.route_structure: Uses @react-router/fs-routes with flatRoutes(). Routes are at web/app/routes/. Dashboard is a layout route at dashboard.tsx with nested child routes.
key_patterns.groups_page: Groups page at routes/groups._index.tsx uses react-router Link directly (not custom Link), with to= prop instead of href=.
key_patterns.topic_list_images: topic-list-item.tsx and article-list.tsx render images without loading='lazy'.
key_patterns.comment_images: comment-list.tsx renders comment images without loading='lazy'.

directory_structure: web/app/routes/ - all page routes (file-system based), web/components/ - reusable components organized by domain, web/lib/ - utilities including api client, router helpers, i18n
